name: GlzSheet
semanticRole: Provide a touch-friendly temporary workspace that enters from a screen edge, supports useful detents, and preserves the underlying context.

material.rule: Sheets use Thick or Solid Glaze according to content density. Medium and large modal sheets may add a subtle scrim; peek sheets may remain modeless.

input.keyboard: Keyboard reaches all sheet controls; Escape closes when safe and modal use restores the invoker.
input.focus: Modal sheets manage initial and contained focus; modeless sheets remain in normal order with a clear close path.
input.hover: Hover is optional and never required for sheet controls.
input.press: Press activates explicit controls; drag may change detents but cannot be the only way to operate the sheet.
input.selection: Detent and selected-control state use non-color cues.

accessibility.role: Use dialog semantics for modal sheets and labeled region or group semantics for modeless peek sheets.
accessibility.name: Provide a stable title or accessible label and a named close affordance.
accessibility.state: Expose open, modal or modeless, busy, error, and supported detent state where applicable.
accessibility.value: Nested controls expose values; detent movement has an accessible equivalent action instead of gesture-only value.
accessibility.keyboard: All functions including detent changes have keyboard or control equivalents and Escape behavior is explicit.
accessibility.focus: Focus behavior matches modality and remains visible through detent changes.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors remain associated with controls and are announced without forcing an unexpected detent.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace edge travel with direct placement or a short crossfade.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen sheet boundary, handle, focus, and scrim separation.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors with no blur or decorative shadow.
accessibility.largeText: At 200% text the sheet expands or scrolls internally and controls remain reachable without horizontal scrolling.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct placement or short crossfades.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen boundaries, focus, handle, and scrim separation.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors and remove blur.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and decorative shadow before changing modality, detents, or target geometry.

content.overflow: Content scrolls inside the sheet; expose only useful detents and never clip primary actions behind viewport edges.
content.localization: Titles and controls tolerate 30–50% expansion; large text may favor a larger detent or full-height layout.
content.rtl: Side sheets mirror start or end placement when semantic; bottom-sheet reading order remains logical.

criteria: Sheet reads as a temporary workspace rather than a permanent page.
Only useful detents are exposed and drag is not the only control path.
Touch controls remain reachable and the sheet adapts cleanly between mobile bottom and desktop side placement.
